acceptance: Root source/report/harness review plus frozen independent evidence; root did not rerun the author or independent suites.
pm1: S1 unchanged; no new scorecard or percentage inference.
execution: Trusted inert local fixtures only; no real network, database, host, private inputs or clock measurement. Broad suites and CI not run.
scope: Typed monotonic budgets, epoch intervals and raw process identity under separate synthetic caller premises. No clock mapping or authenticity resolver.

independent.counts: Controls are separate from the 176 matrix assertions. Groups and assertions overlap; earlier runs are not added.

behavior: Exact all-own-key schemas include hidden fields and reject extra symbols. Dense provenance arrays and named binding validation preserve missing/malformed precedence.
Complete process records and context require matching top-level and binding targets. Raw decimal ticks never pass through Number.
Original monotonic context is detached and cannot be replaced. Backward samples fail without advancing the prior sample; zero remaining grants no admission.
Freshness compares the whole signed interval with checked arithmetic. Expiry equality is expired; file ordering does not prove loaded-code identity.
history: r1 target-coherence failure and r2 hidden-extra-field failure remain immutable. Independent r3 tests cover both repairs.
Author first-run helper error is retained separately; final tests corrected the fixture without relaxing expectations.
limits: Trusted inert data only; no arbitrary getters/proxies or modified-built-in guarantees.
Deadline-reset and detached-capture mutation controls were not run independently; their behavior was tested directly.
No actual mapping, receipt authenticity, precision/drift/suspend calibration, approved limits or TF1/TF2/TF3 integration.
next: Define a bounded local consumer contract before composition; actual clock provenance and target measurements remain separate gates.
